title: Identify the Desired Output
text: The main column should contain the last word of each item name. For example, Orange Chicken should become Chicken, not the full item name and not just the last character.

title: Last Word of an Item
text: For the item Orange Chicken, what should the main ingredient be?

title: Check Option A
text: orders["item"].str.split() splits each item string into a list of words. The final .str[-1] then selects the last word from each list, so this creates the desired main ingredients.

title: Eliminate Options B and C
text: orders["item"].str[-1] selects only the last character of each string, such as $$n$$ from Orange Chicken. str.contains checks whether a pattern exists and returns True or False values, not the extracted ingredient names.

title: Check Option D
text: In r"(\w+)$", \w+ matches one or more word characters, and $ anchors the match to the end of the string. Because the word characters are inside a capturing group, .str.extract(...) extracts the final word from each item name.
